title: Springy Udon Noodle Stir Fry
description: Quick and easy Japanese-style udon noodle stir fry with asparagus and springy sesame oil. A great springtime meal to invigorate your taste buds.
instructions: Bring a large pot of water to a boil and cook the udon noodles according to the package instructions.
Heat the sesame oil in a large skillet or wok over medium-high heat.
Add the asparagus to the skillet and cook for 2-3 minutes, or until tender.
Add the soy sauce, grated ginger, and sesame seeds to the skillet and stir to combine.
Add the cooked udon noodles to the skillet and stir to combine with the sauce.
Cook for an additional 1-2 minutes, or until the noodles are well coated with the sauce.
Optional: garnish with additional sesame seeds and grated ginger if desired.
Note: You can also add protein such as cooked chicken or tofu to the stir fry if desired.
